long_biography.plain_text:
After gaining professional maritime qualifications, Crowther built a career in commercial chartering and technical vessel management. He worked across offshore shipping, marine brokerage and aircraft management, then helped develop a fleet serving offshore-wind construction and oil-and-gas subsea operations. His responsibilities have included charter sales, crewing, engineering oversight and ship operations.

Crowther now serves as consultant manager to Atlantic Oceanic’s United States business and chief executive of Castle Ship Technical Management in Britain. Their work centres on specialist offshore vessels used for survey, cable, construction, towage and subsea support. He also remains a trustee of the Nekton Foundation, contributing maritime and operational experience to ocean-research governance.
